changes.title: Hat art
items: Pick your hat's and broom's powers from a dropdown in your room's Hat and Broom boxes
The Harvest hat's berries now grow on little seedlings
The Cyclone hat raises a swirling whirlwind you can see
The chosen hat power shows its little icon

changes.title: Spell icons
items: Every hat and broom in the creator now has its own little pixel icon

changes.title: Bubble tails
items: Speech and thought bubbles point at their speaker's head now, not the middle of its body, and follow it as it turns and moves
